spec_input: Build a tiny calculator library in Python. Module name: simplecalc. Provide functions add(a,b), subtract(a,b), multiply(a,b), divide(a,b). divide must raise ValueError on division by zero. Acceptance: all four ops are pure functions, no side effects.

specification.description: A tiny calculator library in Python providing pure functions for basic arithmetic operations.
acceptance_criteria: add(a, b) returns a + b without side effects
subtract(a, b) returns a - b without side effects
multiply(a, b) returns a * b without side effects
divide(a, b) raises ValueError when b is 0
